scope: General source-explanation repairs across plumbing, mechanical, fuel gas, fire and building code. Transparency remains a known regression only.

implementation.change: Material wording defects in reviewed noncategorical source explanations can use bounded edits instead of regenerating the entire answer.
implementation.guard: Exact reviewed-answer hash; complete bound-source coverage; valid source-scope envelope; no categorical or unbound project application; only eligible feedback types. Missing/stale/incomplete evidence or unsupported application keeps full revision.
implementation.safety: Immutable authoritative citation identity/text and source IDs; supplied-source-only binding additions; explicit removals and required-coverage guards; existing output/attempt bounds; every patch undergoes fresh full-answer verification.
implementation.limit: The model still selects which editable targets to change. Mechanical preservation of unselected text does not prove semantic completeness.

limitations: Five two-turn conversations; observations are correlated.
